note: A 16:9 video, so every graphic is horizontal. The script asks for the hook text, the title card, the lower third and two chapter cards, so 5 graphics and the end card. The slides are Keith's own PDF pages, not graphics. Captions throughout.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1, big and bold: “THE STAR OF THE SHOW”. Already on screen at 0:00. It does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:04.

mg.title: Title card

text.sub: CureGRIN · Lunch and Learn at GRIN Therapeutics, New York, 8 Oct 2026

mg.cue: Title card, full frame, 5 s: “Keith McArthur” with the line “CureGRIN · Lunch and Learn at GRIN Therapeutics, New York, 8 Oct 2026”.
mg.use: Full frame from 00:07 to 00:12, over the room wide or the slide 1 photo. Music in under it.

mg.title: Lower third
mg.cue: Lower third at 00:12 on his first sync, 4 s: “Keith McArthur” / CEO, CureGRIN Foundation.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:12 for 4 s, lower left above the captions. Type the second line <CEO, CureGRIN Foundation> under the name.

mg.title: Chapter: Part 1
mg.cue: Small chapter card at the start of Part 1, top, 3 s: “Part 1: Bryson's Story”
mg.use: Put it on at the start of C5189 for 3 s, top band, as he says he will talk about Bryson.

mg.title: Chapter: Part 2
mg.cue: Small chapter card at the start of Part 2, top, 3 s: “CureGRIN's Story”
mg.use: Put it on at “So I'm going to turn now” (C5210 00:11) for 3 s, top band.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card: “Support CureGRIN today.” and curegrin.org.
mg.src: endcards/index.json (22 Oct 2026): no CureGRIN logo file yet (Lauren's high-res logo is still owed), so the name is typed until it arrives.
